title: Crunchy
description:
Male | Senior | FCV+ and Stomatitis
Crunchy came to us in December 2023. He is currently our longest staying cat at the shelter. Crunchy is very old and therefore has very little energy. He is very mellow but also super sweet. He would be a perfect lap cat. 
Due to his FCV and stomatitis, he is on prednisone everyday. The meds make him thirsty and he drinks a ton of water.
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Cosco
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3 years) | FHV+
Cosco was brought in as a stray in early 2024. She was pregnant and eventually gave birth at the shelter. All of her kittens were adopted but unfortunately she is still here. She is one of our longest stays currently at the shelter. She is a total sweetheart and loves human interaction. 
She is FHV+ and would need to be an only cat. FHV isn’t as daunting as it sounds. There is no medication for FHV therefore her vet bills would be the same as any other cat! 
Cosco has a cloudy eye and it’s from a scratch that healed. There’s no issue with it!

title: Sophie
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~2-5 years) | FIV+
Sophie came in as a stray in January 2025. She is the perfect mix of sweet and sassy. She loves pets but will let you know when she wants her space. She also does not like other cats. She is FIV+ so she would need to be an only cat anyways. She has not shown any physical symptoms/health issues from the FIV. It was only discovered through routine testing.

title: Domino
description:
Male | Born late 2024/early 2025
The WHHS took in Domino from the reservation in April 2025. Since he came in, he’s been very reserved and keeps to himself. But 2026 might be his year - he’s started to come out of his shell and make his presence known! He’ll gladly take pets and would do better in a calmer home without many animals or kids. He’ll accept pets and when he’s decided he’s finished, he’ll either walk away but sometimes gets salty with a swat, but hey, he’s a cat…

title: Twilight
description:
Female | 1+ year
Twilight was born at the shelter on May 1, 2025. She is the last of her 4 siblings still at the shelter. She is a very relaxed and gentle girl but is getting more and more outgoing (coming up to greet visitors) every day. She is in the cattery and likes to snuggle with the other cats. She’ll gladly take any pets that come her way.

title: Ellie
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3 years)
Ellie came in as a stray in June 2025. Since then she has really opened up. She is quite curious and likes to explore. Ellie loves getting attention and pets as well.

title: Tabby
description:
Female | ~1-2 years
Tabby came to us as a stray in August 2025. She has become more social and affectionate recently and we are so happy to see her happy! But, she would sure be happier in a loving home and out of the kennel. We hope you come and fall in love with this gorgeous gal!

title: Starry
description:
Male | ~1 year
Starry was brought in as a stray in August 2025. He is in a walk in with other kitty friends. He is very playful and loves toys and scratchers. He can be a little shy at first, but once he knows you want to pet him, he’s a happy boy! He’s becoming vocal for more attention and loves to give his kennel pals massages - it’s ADORABLE. Seems curious of dogs!

title: Finn
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~2 years)
Finn came in as a stray in October 2025. Since his first day here, he has been extremely sweet. He is in our cattery with other cats and does well. You’ll often find him snuggled up in a bed but will get up to come greet you.

title: Grace
description:
Female | 14+ years
Grace was one of the 5 cats that came from the hoarding situation on November 20th. She was also severely matted and had to be shaved. Her hair has been growing back nicely! She gets a bit startled by noises and hides but quickly realizes she’s safe and comes back out. She loves to snuggle up on some blankets and enjoys head rubs. Grace does not like other cats and would do best as the only pet in a quiet home. 
Grace likely has a tumor so we’d like to find her a foster for her final months.

title: Cleo Catra
description:
Female | Born April 2022
Probably no other animals | Indoor only
Cleo Catra came to us on 3.27.26. She is a sweet girl that adores pets and is just a little unsure in her new environment. Cleo does not like other animals and will pee on things if other animals are present in the home. She does not like big groups so would do best in a quiet home with fewer people. She might not do well with younger children. She is affectionate to her human and it was a hard surrender for her former owner. Orange females are rare and she’s a total catch.

title: Esmeralda
description:
Female | Born 9/10/2015
No young children, preferably no other pets
Esmeralda and her grey Tortie sister, Eleanor, were brought to us on April 4th, 2026. Their parents were expecting a baby and these cats are not fans of children (many attempts were made to get to know kiddos in the family) so they came to us. Esmeralda does lick when she’s stressed so she has some bald patches or spots with thin hair - she’s still a beauty though! Esmeralda would love to join an adult or two in a quiet home. The sisters don’t get along that well and if adopted together, would likely keep their distance in their new home. 
Esmeralda will come with her automatic feeder when adopted.
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Eleanor
description:
Female | Born 9/10/2015
No young children, no other pets
Eleanor and her Tortie sister, Esmeralda, were brought to us on April 4th, 2026. Their parents were expecting a baby and these cats are not fans of children (many attempts were made to get to know kiddos in the family) so they came to us. Eleanor is a little spicy and would do best in a quiet home with only a few adults that respected her space - she’ll come to you when she wants affection. The sisters don’t get along that well and if adopted together, would likely keep their distance in their new home. 
Eleanor will come with her automatic feeder when adopted. 
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Prego
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~5 years)
No dogs, preferably no cats
Hailey’s favorite kitty! Prego came to us as a pregnant stray in January 2026. She gave birth to 4 healthy babies and they have all been adopted. Like her, they were all named after sauces! Prego is an extremely affectionate cat with a bobtail that enjoys watching out the window, growling at anything out of the ordinary - she’d make a great guard dog! Prego loves to be pet, enjoys lounging around, and is always eager to say “hello!” She is currently in the cattery in her own kennel, where she has more room to roam and to be around other cats and we are curious if she’ll warm up to other kitties now that she doesn’t have kittens. Prego enjoys giving humans kisses!

title: Smores
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~1 year)
Might do well with an older or chill cat & might do well with a small dog
Smores came in with her kittens, Kamp and Fyre, on 5.26.26 after being dumped out on some property. She is happy to be away from her needy boys and relaxing after all her hard work as a mom. She does not appear to like other cats very much and does not like dogs. She’s a real people lover though! Nothing would make her happier than to nap in your lap!

title: Lawrence
description:
Male | Undetermined age 
Lawrence came to us on 5.26.26 after living as a stray. He is a little feisty but is up front to try to work on socializing. The family that kept tabs on him said he was a sweet kitty that they could hold so we look forward to meeting this version of him!

title: Dr. Mittens
description:
Male | Born 2022-2023
ON HOLD
Dr. Mittens came to us as a sad cat named Mittens in early June 2026. He had terrible ear mites and was destroying his own ears from the pain and itchiness. He is a large kitty that has finally found some relief after medicine and rest. He is coming out of his shell and is a total lovebug! He can be scared at first (we don’t think his former humans were too kind to him) but is a silly boy that rolls around playfully. He tempts you with belly rubs, but does not actually enjoy them… He still has some wounds healing, but we are so happy his heart and trust in humans are beginning to heal too. Give this big ol’ orange boy the love and home he deserves…

title: Spino
description:
Male | Born 4.1.2015
Spino came to us at 11 years old in June 2026. He is a senior that is taking time to adjust but we are looking forward to getting to know this sweet older boy. He’ll be in our senior room and we’ve love for you to come fall for this big hunk. 
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Arthur
description:
Male | Born 2024
Arthur is a young, handsome fella looking for his new forever home! He came to us June 2026 after his owner was unable to continue to care for him. He was very loved and has a lot of personality. He’s ready to start his next chapter would love another cat to play with. Seems curious of dogs!

title: Thackery Binx
description:
Male | Born around 5/11/26 
Taking applications, not available until after neuter
Thackery is the most outgoing of his siblings! He likes to climb, he loves to meow, he loves to cuddle, and he’s super playful. He’s the total package!

title: Nox
description:
Female | Born around 5/11/26
Taking applications, not available until after spay
Nox is a chill little female. She is playful, but never plays too hard with her siblings. She is quiet but loves to play and is gaining confidence. Look at her sweet face!

title: MooMoo
description:
Female | Born ~4.24.26
Taking applications, not available until after spay
The spiciest of the “ice cream” babies. MooMoo is slowly learning to trust humans after living as a feral. Come give her some love!

title: Chaco Taco
description:
Female | Born ~4.24.26
Taking applications, not available until after spay
Chaco Taco is coming around and learning humans give treats and pets so they aren’t so bad. Choco Taco has gorgeous green eyes and we think they might stick! Her and her “ice cream” siblings are excited for their next adventure!

title: Tildy
description:
Female | 8 years old
Tildy is around 8 years old. She came to us in June 2026 after her elderly owner could no longer care for her and no family could keep her. She came in with severe mats and we have worked to shave those away and she sure does feel better now! She is quite the adventurer in her new space, but also loves to be lazy. She has lived with cats, dogs, men, women, and children, so she should acclimate to any home well! 
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Hambone
description:
Male | ~1 year old 
Application Pending
Hambone came to us as a stray in June 2026. He is the sweetest boy that hangs out in the silliest positions! If you want a lover boy, he’s purrrfect! He doesn’t seem bothered by his neighboring cats and met a small dog that he allowed to lick his ears!

title: Chongus
description:
Male | ~1 year old
Chongus came to us as a stray and we believed him to be feral. He’s not feral at all but he’s pretty scared. He’s a giant sweetie that would do well in a quiet home where he can come out of his shell.

title: Zeus
description:
Male | 13 years old 
Waiting on bloodwork for skin concerns, we know he will need dental work
Zeus is a Maine Coon mix - a BIG boy! He’s an older gentlemen that needs some TLC and he will be visiting the groomer on 7/8/26 for a much needed shave and bath. He’ll be feeling fresh and looking for his forever home. He has lived with cats, dogs, and children. He does get defensive with dogs if they are too “up-in-his-business.”
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Posie
description:
Female | Born 6.5.2020
Front declaw - Indoor only!
Posie came to us July 7, 2026. She is a sweet little gal that is shy around other cats but we hope to help her gain confidence. She was surrendered for peeing on beds and laundry. We have had a lot of success with cats with temperamental cats just needing a change of space. She’s a doll that has lived with other cats and children and is a bit nervous around younger, loud children.

title: Coati
description:
Male | Born ~2023
Coati came to us after being a stray turned pet that just never fit in with his adoptive family. He was called Mittens but we decided that he needed a more unique name for his unique look! He is said to be nervous around men, can warm up to children but prefers adults, and has a habit of picking fights with other cats. He was recently neutered so we hope he can make kitty friends here! He has not lived with dogs but was introduced to a small dog here at WHHS and seemed curious. He’s used to being outside but does enjoy the company of humans. He just arrived on 7/9/26 so we are still getting to know him while he adjusts.

title: Nova
description:
Female | Australian Shepherd Mix | 6 yrs
No young children(12+), No cats
Nova is back from her foster adventure! We learned that she really will do best with only one human in the house and being the only pet. She still needs slow introductions even when in her new home. She had great manners without accidents in her foster home and was not destructive so she would not need to be kenneled when left home alone. Please ask questions and we’d be happy to get you in touch with her former foster dad if you want to get to know her more! 
Our longest term resident! Nova was brought in with a male dog and a puppy in 2022, though she remains. Being in the shelter for so long has made her reactive and sassy, therefore she requires a slow introduction. For most new introductions we muzzle her to keep everyone safe. Once she is comfortable with you, she is very affectionate. We call her “Our Princess.” 
She does not get along with female dogs but has shown little to no aggression towards male dogs. Give her some time, you’ll love her as much as we do! 
Nova weighs around 30 pounds.

title: Peyton
description:
Male | Lab/St. Bernard/German Shepherd | 7 yrs
Careful with children, Some Dogs 
Peyton came to us on 12/29/25. He’s a big, bouncy, and kind of naughty boy - Peyton has unfortunately used his teeth in ways he’s not supposed to, but does know sit, stay, and shake! Once he knows you, he really is a sweet boy. He’s got the most handsome bark and would do nearly anything for food or treats! Peyton loves small stuffed toys, car rides, chewable treats, bones, and snuggles. Be prepared for a little drool on his favorite toys.
Peyton weighs 85 pounds. 
Likely has cancer (growth on leg) and we are looking for a hospice foster. Please inquire with us for more info!

title: Lilac
description:
Female | Coohound Mix | Born 8/5/2022
Currently being fostered!
No young kids(12+) no cats, some dogs
This pretty lady came to us on 4/7/2026. She is a great dog who is just a bit particular. She’s not a big fan of some people (some men, some elderly) and does not get along with all dogs in a household setting. Lilac has been to doggy daycare in Rapid City at Meadowridge Pet Lodge, and gets along with dogs in a neutral setting. She has some separation anxiety and can be a bit destructive when left home alone, though she hasn’t shown any destructive behavior spending nights with one of our employees. She is not a fan of small children. If you have further question regarding Lilac, please reach out through our email. Lilac weighs around 50 lbs.

title: Gus
description:
Male | Lab Mix | ~8 years
Good w/ dogs that give him space
Gus was brought to us as a stray on 4/24/26. No one came for this sweet old man. We aren’t sure how he feels about cats (seems like he’s hunting them but might just be curious) yet seems fine with his neighboring dogs as he has plenty of space. He’s very sweet and well-mannered, though he likes to jump up on you when he’s excited! We aren’t sure of his age - his face says 10 but the vet guesses 8 years. regardless of age, Gus gets around great! He jumps into cars, runs to his kennels, pulls our dog walkers around, and digs to his hearts’ content! Gus weighs about 74 lbs. 
Gus is a senior & available for a senior rate. Give us a call or come meet him!

title: Cutlass
description:
Male | Heeler/Doberman Mix | Born 3/8/23
No cats, no male dogs, no small kids(12+)
Cutlass came to us on 4/30/26 after his owner passed away. He does not like cats or male dogs, though he doesn’t seem to mind female dogs. We think he would do better with older kids, a fenced yard, and/or living with someone who is very active! Cutlass has a lot energy to burn and absolutely loves the water! He’s a lake or creek playing dog for sure. Cutlass is a little finicky upon new introductions, but once he warms up, he’s a real hambone. We invite you to come visit him and see if you could be his next best friend! Cutlass is 50 lbs.

title: Guster
description:
Male | Shepherd Mix | Born 2025
No cats, some dogs, great with kids
Guster (formally Junior) is back with us after not fitting in with his family. They gave it a go but he did not get along with the family cat and did not care for one of the family members who owns their own dogs outside of their house. Unfortunately, it did end with a bite. Guster is a squeaker-removing champion, a lover of hard squeaking toys, and a bit of a fence jumper. He does very well with younger kids and would do best as the only pet, but we can facilitate a meet-and-greet with another dog to see if they get along. Guster weighs 40 lbs.

title: Akasha
description:
Female | Shepherd/Heeler/Husky Mix | Born 4/17/23
No cats, careful with kids, some dogs
Akasha and her “sister,” Harlequinn, are with us after not being able to return home. They are sweet girls that get along with each other but don’t seem to be a big fan of other dogs and would probably chase cats if given the chance. Akasha seems a bit more willing to meet other dogs. We know they are both playful and enjoy human companionship. 
Akasha weighs 42 pounds

title: Harlequinn
description:
Female | Lab/Pit Mix | Born 3/20/24
No other dogs
Harlequinn and her “sister,” Akasha, are with us after not being able to return home. They are sweet girls and get along with each other but don’t seem to be a big fan of other dogs and would probably chase cats if given the chance. We know they are both playful and enjoy human companionship. Harley is a lover of people and jumps up on you when she’s excited!
Harlequinn weighs 48 pounds

title: Mocha
description:
Female | English Mastador/Lab Mix | Born 2025
Mocha and her sister, Shyra, came to us on 6/4/26 after their owner could no longer care for them. We are still getting to know them but we are told they take a while to warm up to men, they are pretty cautious, they don’t like the car, but they enjoy going for walks and running around playing with toys. Mocha is the more confident of the two. We look forward to getting to know these beauties and sharing more about them in the near future! They do get along but do not have to be adopted together. Enjoy the photo of this gal singing the song of her people on arrival. Mocha weighs around 90 pounds.

title: Shyra
description:
Female | English Mastador/Lab Mix | Born 2025
Shyra and her sister, Mocha, came to us on 6/4/26 after their owner could no longer care for them. We are still getting to know them but we are told they take a while to warm up to men, they are pretty cautious, they don’t like the car, but they enjoy going for walks and running around playing with toys. Shyra is the more timid of the two. We look forward to getting to know these beauties and sharing more about them in the near future! They do get along but do not have to be adopted together. Enjoy the photo of this gal singing the song of her people on arrival. Shyra weighs around 83 pounds.

title: Flash
description:
Male | Terrier/Retriever Mix | DOB 4/18/2024
Cats unknown, Loves people
Flash came to us after his owner went to college and he keeps escaping from home. He is a very energetic little man who loves attention. He jumps up for loving and kisses but knows commands. He knows sit, shake, lay down, stand, and high five. I’m a lover boy who wants to ride on home with my new owner! Flash weighs about 45 pounds.

title: Valkyrie
description:
Female | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | 5+ years
Valkyrie came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children. 
Valkyrie has a facial wound (not pictured) that she is on meds for. She may have permanent paralysis in her left eye (and maybe the surrounding area) that may lead to lifelong drops multiple times a day, or the eye can be removed. She is up-to-date on vaccinations. 
Valkyrie is sweet, loyal, and needs somewhere to heal. We are accepting applications for fostering or adoption. She’s available now and with an approved application, we will schedule a meet-and-greet to ensure you’re a match. She does have a spay appt scheduled July 15th.

title: Fenrir
description:
Male | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | 1+ year old
Fenrir came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children.
Fenrir is a bit shy but starting to warm up. He enjoys playing with his kennel mate, Phoenix. 
He will be able for foster or adoption on July 8th, after being neutered and getting his rabies shot. We are accepting applications now and if approved for adoption for fostering, we will do a meet-and greet to ensure you’re a match!

title: Faerie
description:
Female | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | <1 year old
Faerie came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children. 
Faerie has lots of puppy energy! She’s sweet, playful, and loves to give kisses. 
She will be able for foster or adoption on July 8th, after being spayed and getting her rabies shot. We are accepting applications now and if approved for adoption for fostering, we will do a meet-and greet to ensure you’re a match!

title: Centaur
description:
Male | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | 1+ year old
Centaur came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children. 
Centaur is very outgoing, loves attention, and is a big fan of giving kisses. He’s a lover boy.
He will be able for foster or adoption on July 8th, after being neutered and getting his rabies shot. We are accepting applications now and if approved for adoption for fostering, we will do a meet-and greet to ensure you’re a match!

title: Chimera
description:
Female | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | 1+ year old
Chimera came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children. 
Chimera is a sweetheart that loves to give kisses and would make a wonderful companion for a family or individual. 
Foster lined up following spay! We are accepting applications for adoption. She’s available now and with an approved application, we will schedule a meet-and-greet to ensure you’re a match. She does have a spay appt scheduled July 15th.

title: Phoenix
description:
Male | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | 1+ year old
Phoenix came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children. 
Phoenix is the most brave and excited to meet people. He warmed up to his new home here quickly, but is looking forward to having someone fall in love with him!
He will be able for foster or adoption on July 8th, after being neutered and getting his rabies shot. We are accepting applications now and if approved for adoption for fostering, we will do a meet-and greet to ensure you’re a match!

title: Nessie
description:
Female | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | <1 year old 
Nessie came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children. 
Nessie is the most shy but is coming out of her shell. She takes a while to warm up but is getting more confident and is a total wiggle-butt! 
She will be able for foster or adoption on July 15th, after being spayed and getting her rabies shot. We are accepting applications now and if approved for adoption for fostering, we will do a meet-and greet to ensure you’re a match!

title: Uni
description:
Male | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | <1 year old
Uni came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children. 
Uni is a sweet little boy full of energy! His broken leg will hopefully heal after a surgery to repair it on July 2nd. He is up-to-date on vaccinations and neutered.
He is currently in a foster home but we are accepting applications for his adoption. Once an application is accepted, we can set up a meet-and-greet to ensure you’re a match!

title: Nemo
description:
Male | Shepherd Mix | ~6 months
Pictured here in his “donut of shame” after being neutered. 
Nemo was believed to be dumped with his “sister” at Sugar Shack in July 2026. He’s definitely been through a lot and needs training, especially on a leash. He’s a sweet boy that wants to find his person that he feels safe with. He’s gaining weight and full of puppy energy! Nemo weighs 25 lbs.

title: Dory
description:
Female | Belgian Malinois Mix | ~9 months
Pictured in her fashionable “cone” following her spay. 
Dory was believed to be dumped with her “brother” at Sugar Shack in July 2026. She is definitely been through a lot and needs training, especially on a leash. She is a sweet girl with lots of energy and she does like to jump. She is gaining weight and full of kisses! Dory weighs 33 lbs.
